description: This Java class 'WidgetWorker' provides utility methods for constructing URIs, creating HTML elements, managing request context, and handling widget-related operations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WidgetWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for widget operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildHyperlinkUri
methods.description: Constructs a URI for hyperlinks based on target, type, parameters, and request context, handling intra- and inter-application links, content URLs, and CSRF tokens.

methods.name: getContentUrl
methods.description: Generates a content URL with proper prefix based on the request context.

methods.name: makeHiddenFormLinkAnchorElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor element for a hidden form link with optional styling, description, confirmation, and image.

methods.name: makeHiddenFormLinkFormElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML form element configured for submitting hidden parameters to a target URL.

methods.name: makeLinkHiddenFormName
methods.description: Generates a unique form name based on context and form field information.

methods.name: determineAutoLinkType
methods.description: Determines whether a link should be an 'auto' type, resolving to 'hidden-form' or 'anchor' based on request mapping.

methods.name: getScriptLocation
methods.description: Extracts the script location from a combined name of format 'location#methodName'.

methods.name: getScriptMethodName
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a combined script name, or returns null if not present.

methods.name: getScreenStack
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a ScreenStack object from the context.

methods.name: getJwtCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT callback ID from the context or parameters.

methods.name: getPaginatorNumber
methods.description: Gets the current paginator number from the context, initializing if absent.

methods.name: incrementPaginatorNumber
methods.description: Increments the paginator number in the global context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher object from the context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator object from the context.

methods.name: resolveParametersMapFromQueryString
methods.description: Parses the '_QBESTRING_' parameter from context into a map of query parameters.
